name: Cache and Single-Flight Behavior
description: Cache identical LLM requests (same model, messages, parameters) to avoid redundant API calls. Single-flight coalesces concurrent identical requests into a single inflight request — the first request triggers the API call, subsequent identical requests attach to the same pending promise rather than starting new calls.
purpose: Reduce redundant API calls and associated costs by caching deterministic responses and coalescing concurrent duplicate requests into a single backend invocation.
acceptanceCriteria: Cache key is hash of: model, messages (ordered), temperature, maxTokens, stop, tools (ordered), toolChoice
Cache stores successful responses with TTL
Single-flight deduplication: 5 identical concurrent requests become 1 API call, 5 waiters share the result
Cache hit returns response metadata (cached=true, cachedAt)
Cache can be bypassed per-request with skipCache flag
Cache TTL is configurable per-model (cheaper models may have shorter TTL)
Cache entries evicted on provider version changes or model deprecation
Streaming responses are not cached (only non-streaming)
